primary_outcome: force or energy MAE on the common held-out AIMD trajectory
normalization: negative MAE, min-max normalized within each matched stride decision
interpretation_boundary: Each panel fixes material system, framework, adaptation mode, configuration count, endpoint, trainer, and test trajectory while changing only AIMD subsampling stride.
Stride 100 spans a trajectory about ten times longer than stride 10 at the same DFT-labeled configuration count. Reference-trajectory generation cost is recorded separately from final label count.
The release contains one trained model per arm. Variation across training seeds is not recoverable for these stride comparisons.
Energy and force remain separate endpoints because their absolute units and loss weightings differ.
